name: email-verification
title: Email verification
description: Prove that people own their email address: a single use link (stored hashed, 24 hour expiry) after registration and after every address change, resend with a per address cooldown, emailVerified on the user and in /auth/me, a 'verified' policy token, and optional enforcement at sign-in or on every route.
docs:
Registering sends a link to APP_URL/verify-email?token=... (option linkUrl). That page calls POST /api/auth/verify-email { token } -> { verified, email }.
Resend: POST /api/auth/verify-email/resend (signed in) or { email } (signed out) -> 202. Admins: POST /api/admin/users/:userId/verify-email.
The user gets emailVerified and emailVerifiedAt (GET /api/auth/me). Protect routes with policy: 'verified' (or 'verified | admin'): 403 EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED.
Options (calm.config.js blocks['email-verification']): required (false | 'routes' | 'login'), ttlHours, cooldownSeconds, linkUrl, sendOnRegister, sendOnEmailChange, notifyOldEmail, allow.

links.title: OWASP Forgot Password Cheat Sheet (token handling)

agents:
- Read `app/blocks/email-verification/index.js` first: the header comment lists every route and the security rules.
- Options live in `calm.config.js` under `blocks['email-verification']`; `required` is `false`, `'routes'` or `'login'`, nothing else.
- Never store or log a raw token: only `hashToken(token)` goes to `calm_email_verifications`. The raw token only exists in the email.
- Tokens are claimed with one atomic `findOneAndUpdate` on `usedAt: null`; keep that, a read then a write lets two clicks both pass.
- A link proves the address it was sent to (`email` on the record). Keep the check `user.email === claimed.email` in the verify route.
- `emailVerified` and `emailVerifiedAt` are added to the user resource in `calm.onResource` and are read-only: never make them writable by clients. Use `app.ext.emailVerification.markVerified(userId)` from other code.
- The resend route must answer the same body for known and unknown addresses and do the lookup in `calm.app.background`. Do not add 'user not found' errors.
- Protect a route with `policy: 'verified'` (or `'verified | admin'`); the guard turns the denial into `403 EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED`.
- With `required` on, unverified users can still call the routes in `ALWAYS_ALLOWED` plus `options.allow` ('METHOD /path' as written in the route, without /api).
- Changing the email (PATCH /api/auth/me or the user CRUD) resets verification in `beforeUpdate` of the user service; do not move that to an event listener, it must be the same update.
- A sign-in through `POST /auth/magic-link/verify` marks the user verified in the login challenge (the link proved the inbox); keep that path check in sync if the magic-link prefix changes.
- Accounts created before the block have no `emailVerified` field and count as unverified; `calm doctor` reports how many.
- Tests: `test/blocks/email-verification.test.js` in the CalmAPI repo shows every flow; in a project, use `t.mails` and `t.idle()` to read the link.
